purpose: Use Lumen wait time for current-source grounding and x2 build/use preparation instead of idle polling.

sources.name: OpenAI Codex changelog
sources.takeaway: Codex app and CLI updates improve goal continuity, plugin visibility, browser/developer surfaces, Codex CLI web search, richer tool schemas, doctor diagnostics, plugin marketplace responsiveness, and TUI/session reliability.

sources.name: Model Context Protocol specification 2025-06-18
sources.takeaway: MCP should be treated as a stateful, capability-negotiated protocol for resources, prompts, tools, roots, sampling, elicitation, cancellation, and logging, with explicit trust and safety concerns.

sources.name: OWASP Agentic AI threats and mitigations
sources.takeaway: Agentic systems require threat-model-based governance, clear mitigations, and separation between autonomous planning and privileged action.

sources.name: GitHub Actions secure use reference
sources.takeaway: Automation should default to least privilege, avoid plaintext secrets, reduce token permissions, use masking carefully, and keep workflow/publish authority under explicit review.

x2_preparation_tasks: Fold Codex changelog improvements into browser bridge and CLI lane readiness checks.
Keep omega-mini as the default sibling catch-up branch and record full omega only as archive fallback.
Model each sibling lane as a scoped actor with least-privilege, status-only publication, and explicit completion markers.
Treat browser transmission as an external side effect guarded by user authorization and status-only receipts.
Upgrade v531 x2 closeout to separate launch, completion, marker, source, and route-health evidence rows.
Add MCP-style capability negotiation language to future multiplex IPC bus receipts.
Keep GitHub read-only sibling access separated from Aletheon write/publish authority.
Preserve proof gates and canon gates as open unless exact closure artifacts are produced.
Use source ledgers to justify runner changes, not as claim proof.
Reject raw transcript, route handle, thread ID, credential, local-path, and image publication.
